scope: Real paid cultural commands and the current exposure-only weather consequence; prototype evidence, not default activation or proof of enjoyment.

controlled.weatherProbabilities: Exactly one selected adverse class receives probabilityBps 10000; all other values remain current default rules.
controlled.measureAt: First real outgoing-weather annual mortality assessment; incoming Winter tick zero.
controlled.expansionRule: After the initial100 seeds per class, expand that class to1000 predeclared seeds only when fewer than10 paired seeds have a different resident death count between none and one. This is a rare-outcome precision rule, not permission to select favourable seeds.

strategies.livestock: Current committed FjordLivestock.fjordLivestockRules, independently seeded by the existing Core factory.
strategies.domesticManagement: No manual occupation, building, slaughter, assignment, expedition or purchase commands in any arm. Preserve existing autonomous careers, partnerships, births, care, weather and CPU stepping.

policy.decisionPoint: Once per Summer tick500, beginning at founding, before advancing the next1000 canonical ticks.
policy.one: When the bank is empty, attempt one currently allowed real sponsorship if Food after payment remains at least12.
policy.two: At each decision point refill to the saved cap, stopping at the first ineligible, insufficient-stock or reserve-limited offer.
policy.reserveStatus: QA-only policy choice, not a Core eligibility rule; a15-Food start permits one actual3-Food payment.

strategies.worldScope: The public headless createCampaign graph and all its independently stepped CPU clans; no physical route, renderer, discovery or expedition assertions.
strategies.fullRunGate: Pilot seeds1-8 must all complete with source fingerprints unchanged, exact accounting, save roundtrip, repeated representative case and CPU-isolation checks before seeds9-32 are added.

measurements: real event IDs and participant snapshots
outgoing weather and actual risk inputs
production, consumption, shortages, Food and Materials
observation.annualStrategyTime: Summer tick500; each interval is split only through real AdvanceTicks commands around the annual boundary to observe pre-assessment exposure.
observation.counterfactualLanguage: Paired mortality differences are observer diagnostics; do not create Saved/Averted lore events or claim certainty about an individual's alternate fate.
observation.uncertainty: Per-seed paired mean differences with95% normal intervals where variable; Wilson95% intervals for the proportion of seeds with any death-count change, including zero observations. Cohorts remain exploratory.

execution.rawFormat: One JSONL record per campaign, including bounded annual observations; no per-tick state dumps.
execution.resume: Skip only complete cases with the identical frozen fingerprint. Preserve incomplete-tail evidence before recovery; never drop biological failures or extinct clans.

interpretation.equalSeeds: Do not claim identical realized multi-year weather after differential death/family draws alter the shared mechanics RNG.
interpretation.ordinaryRollout: Requires measured benefit and separate owner review; this study does not activate defaults.
